question: Exactly count every source/twist shifted coordinate overlap on all ten original fixtures and independently verify finite/genus-two counts and fixed Frobenius-factor controls.

claims.text: All fixed shift counts match an independent square-table point census, including zero and malformed-count controls.
Exactly c=1,3 genus-two point counts and Frobenius-factor flags match PARI with ten known-cover and ten corrupted-polynomial controls.
No novelty, cost, short-orbit mixing, general scalar map, NIST security or full-IC result.

arms.description: One native producer execution on the entire original ten-fixture all-shift panel; independent audit and embedded correctness controls certify its output.
A separate actual native invocation recomputes all counts by square-root multiplicities and checks the producer; GP and factor replay certify the fixed polynomial subset.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact complete finite count, no performance or sampling inference.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No separate experimental arm: the independent verifier and GP replay embed all ten known elliptic-cover factor controls, plus separate pre-data small-curve/unit controls. No detector-null conclusion without their pass.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No separate experimental arm: zero shift, a false plus-one count at every shift, and P+1 wrong-factor controls are embedded and explicitly counted by the independent verifier.

independent.name: fixed complete panel
levels: all original fixtures and every shift

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: One pinned Rust producer/verifier and separately pinned native PARI implementation.
factors.how: Record source/binary hashes before data; reopen raw hashes.

factors.name: inputs
factors.value: All ten existing fixtures; c=0..p-1; PARI c=1,3 only, no targets or seed selection.
factors.how: Complete finite exhaustion; never infer prefix mixing from full-universe density.

factors.name: host
factors.value: Same local L0 managed host; no native clock or cost admitted.

factors.name: analyst
factors.value: Shared author and host, deterministic exact equality only.
factors.how: Independent code, square-table finite census, GP factor controls and Lean sign identity.

comparisons.threshold: Exact agreement for every shift and all 30 GP polynomial rows; all embedded controls must pass.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Two actual complete-panel exact executions, producer then independent verifier; no comparative performance.

seed_derivation.note: Deterministic fixed input panel and exhaustive shifts; seed field zero is metadata only.

instance_sampling.rule: The one instance is the complete ten-fixture panel, with every shift. No per-shift independent target inference.

blinding.how: Exact finite verification only; no statistical or comparative claim.

power.note: Exact complete finite counts and necessary-factor checks, not statistical inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Unmeasured prospective watchdog envelope: producer 600s, independent verifier 600s, GP 300s, receipt/admission allowance. Not a runtime observation.

primary.name: Independently verified field shifts
primary.definition: Every c=0..p-1 on all ten fixtures, with explicit singular zero-shift distinction.

counters: GP polynomial and embedded control counts

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly all shifts on the ten fixed fixtures; 20 overlap and ten known-cover polynomials; retain bounded failures at the declared per-stage caps. No post-outcome enlargement or pruning.

decision_rule.text: Admit only complete independent count equality, all embedded controls, strict GP replay and exact native factor recheck.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact finite equality and fixed polynomial divisibility, not runtime or DLP success.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Counts and exact characteristic polynomials only.

graphs: Exact per-fixture overlap ranges and factor-detection controls; native aggregates only.

inadmissible: Interpreting full-universe density as finite-prefix mixing or solving speed
Claiming a DLP map from a Frobenius factor flag
Calling a bounded sample of 20 genus-two polynomials a census of all genus-two factors
Dropping zeros, controls or capped runs
Post-data protocol or source replacement without an explicit later amendment
Novelty, NIST security, full IC/rho or complete formal Legendre/genus/Weil claims

literature.claim: Pre-data review of repository, canonical atlas and local PARI primary help; online access failures explicit.
literature.verified_by: Read and recorded before source/protocol freeze.

extensions.backend_authority: Existing user authorization; same documented EKS-access local fallback as execution-v4. No new paid resource.
